utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive got a few more sign-ups while I was out—people seem to be getting behind it. If you want, I can swing by and see what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Ira—thanks. I’ll check in too and see what gaps are left.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll stop by after errands and report back on anything they’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring whatever tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and let people know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep reminding folks and pass along any updates I hear. We’ll make sure the repair drive gets good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the date and what repairs are needed for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure on the date yet—I heard there’s a repair drive coming up soon, but I don’t have the full details on what all needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll wait for the date and the repair list before doing anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring a few extra supplies for the repair drive—just tell me what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — we still need tape, a couple screwdrivers, and some spare gloves if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape and spare gloves, and I can grab a couple screwdrivers too. I’ll bring them by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’m happy to help bridge the two groups for the repair drive. Let’s make sure everyone knows where to show up and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds good, but can you confirm the exact meeting spot and what we should bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — let’s meet at the community center entrance, and please bring work gloves, a water bottle, and any basic tools you already have.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout already — folks seem ready to pitch in. If you want, I can share what I’ve learned about what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’d help — what do they still need? I’d like to check the details before I sign up for anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly hands-on help, a few tools, and some extra supplies like screws and tape. I can keep an ear out for the full list if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I can help out; I just need to write myself a note so I don’t forget again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that would really help. I’m just trying to keep the timing and drop-off details from getting messy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll jot down the timing and drop-off spot right now, so we keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of the repair drive locations if you want—just tell me the stops and I’ll note them down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be wonderful, Opal—thank you! I’ll send you the stops as soon as I have the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—send them over whenever you’re ready, and I’ll keep them organized.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I’m glad you asked. We need volunteers to sort donations, hand out tools, and help folks sign up for repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort donations and help with sign-ups. Just tell me when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit all over the place today, but I can help if you remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We still need to sort the drop-off spot and make sure the labeled boxes go to the community hall by 4.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll help sort the drop-off spot and get the labeled boxes to the community hall by 4.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No trouble, Dane. It’s going fine—just bring what you’ve got, and we’ll sort it out in order.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ve got a few things to drop off. I’ll get in line and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: tell me the date, the start time, and what I should bring, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — it’s Saturday at 9:00 AM, and please bring gloves if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — I’ll be there Saturday at 9:00 AM with gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m thinking we start around 10 a.m. and go until early afternoon—does that fit the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 a.m. should work for me, and early afternoon is fine too. I’ll make sure it doesn’t conflict with pickup.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the logistics—do we have enough time and a clear plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, we should be fine if we keep it simple—I’ll repeat the plan to everyone and make sure the timing is clear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot—can we also confirm who’s bringing what so nothing gets missed?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it’s still on. I’ll bring the tools over and we can start after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming—it’s still on for after lunch, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you decided what to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m thinking I can bring some tools or maybe a tray of sandwiches—sorry, I keep forgetting what I promised. What would help most?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Tools would be most useful. Can you bring a basic wrench set and a screwdriver kit?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout this time — folks have really been pitching in. I can swing by later and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Tess. I’m glad it’s getting some help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll stop by later and check what still needs doing. If you hear any last-minute needs, just holler!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with that. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — the porch step is the first thing I’d like to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay — I can start there. I’ll bring a few basic tools and take a look at the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Noah—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Mara — I could use help sorting the tools and maybe handing out the flyers. I’ve been a bit all over the place, so that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can sort the tools and hand out the flyers. Let me know when and where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll help get the word out about the repair drive. Want me to invite folks on the block and see who can lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be great, Quinn. Just let folks know we’re looking for a few extra hands and tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll start with the block and ask around for extra hands and tools. I’ll let you know who’s in!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Cleo—thank you. I’ll make a simple list once you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll go through the shed and pantry now, then I’ll let you know what we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things quiet and simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—how much can you spare, and when should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can spare a small amount today, and you can come by this evening. Please keep it private.
